title: Add shared DoseLogging.logDose() suspend function
description: Extracts the dose-logging business logic (timing evaluation, DoseLog insert, conditional next-dose reminder scheduling) that previously lived only inside DailyListViewModel.logDose(), so it can also be called headlessly from LogDoseFromNotificationReceiver without duplicating the logic. notifyOnNextDoseOverride lets a caller with an explicit UI choice (the AddDoseDialog toggle) force it either way; null means 'use the live Settings default' (the notification-action path, which has no UI to ask).
acceptance_criteria: object DoseLogging with a suspend fun logDose(context, doseLogRepository, medicationRepository, settingsRepository, profileId, medicationId, givenAtEpochMillis, doseAmount, acknowledgeWarning, notifyOnNextDoseOverride: Boolean?): LogDoseOutcome
Timing evaluation and TooSoon/NeedsConfirmation short-circuit logic matches the original DailyListViewModel.logDose exactly
The DoseLog is always inserted regardless of notifyOnNextDose
ExactAlarmScheduler.schedule(...) is called with the new profileId/medicationId/medication.defaultDose arguments only when notifyOnNextDose && nextEligible != null && medication != null
exact_code:
package com.taylordproductivty.med_timing_tracker.data

import android.content.Context
import com.taylordproductivty.med_timing_tracker.notifications.ExactAlarmScheduler
import com.taylordproductivty.med_timing_tracker.notifications.ReminderMessage
import com.taylordproductivty.med_timing_tracker.ui.LogDoseOutcome
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first

object DoseLogging {
    suspend fun logDose(
        context: Context,
        doseLogRepository: DoseLogRepository,
        medicationRepository: MedicationRepository,
        settingsRepository: SettingsRepository,
        profileId: Int,
        medicationId: Int,
        givenAtEpochMillis: Long,
        doseAmount: String,
        acknowledgeWarning: Boolean,
        notifyOnNextDoseOverride: Boolean?,
    ): LogDoseOutcome {
        val medication = medicationRepository.getById(medicationId)
        val mostRecentDose = doseLogRepository.getMostRecentDoseSnapshot(profileId, medicationId)
        val timing = DoseTimingCalculator.evaluateTiming(
            givenAtEpochMillis,
            mostRecentDose,
            medication?.minIntervalMinutes,
        )
        if (timing is DoseTimingResult.TooSoon && !acknowledgeWarning) {
            return LogDoseOutcome.NeedsConfirmation(timing.minutesRemaining)
        }
        val nextEligible = DoseTimingCalculator.computeNextEligible(
            givenAtEpochMillis,
            medication?.minIntervalMinutes,
        )
        val doseLogId = doseLogRepository.insert(
            DoseLog(
                profileId = profileId,
                medicationId = medicationId,
                givenAtEpochMillis = givenAtEpochMillis,
                doseAmount = doseAmount,
                nextEligibleAtEpochMillis = nextEligible,
                wasOverrideWarningAcknowledged = timing is DoseTimingResult.TooSoon,
            ),
        )
        val notifyOnNextDose = notifyOnNextDoseOverride ?: settingsRepository.settings.first().notificationsEnabled
        if (notifyOnNextDose && nextEligible != null && medication != null) {
            val (title, text) = ReminderMessage.build(context, medication.name, nextEligible)
            ExactAlarmScheduler.schedule(
                context,
                doseLogId.toInt(),
                nextEligible,
                title,
                text,
                profileId,
                medicationId,
                medication.defaultDose,
            )
        }
        return LogDoseOutcome.Logged
    }
}
